patch_description: This version keeps the direct-link reward, but limits the total two-hop reward for each origin–destination pair to 75% of its direct-link reward. Candidate routes are weighted by transit-node pressure and the direct demand on their component links, so indirect support favors less congested paths. The cap prevents a pair with many possible intermediates from accumulating excessive reward. A moderately stronger degree penalty is intended to encourage more feasible samples before repair.
